question: How many recall events (not individual product records) started for pacemakers (LWP) from 2022-01-01 onwards?
answer:
**3 pacemaker (LWP) recall events** have started since 2022-01-01. Together they cover **26 individual recall records**. All three are Boston Scientific recalls of the ACCOLADE family of pacemakers and CRT-Ps.

- **Event 95969, started 2024-12-12** (4 records, e.g. [Z-0822-2025] to [Z-0825-2025]): some devices built before September 2018 are more likely to go into Safety Mode during telemetry or other higher-power operations because of latent high battery impedance. Root cause listed: process design.
- **Event 97467, started 2025-08-20** (e.g. [Z-0079-2026] to [Z-0087-2026]): a software update meant to stop Safety Mode from starting in an ambulatory setting due to high battery impedance. Root cause listed: other.
- **Event 98615, started 2026-03-19** ([Z-1770-2026]): a software maintenance release (SMR6), with the advisory expanded to all CRT-P and dual-chamber extended-life devices. Root cause listed: nonconforming material/component.

The recall records go past 2024, but the adverse-event reports in this dataset only run from 2022 to 2024. Only the December 2024 event started inside the period those reports cover.
